distinct_mechanism: Exploitation of transition prediction error in prioritized experience replay (PER) to starve victim-task replay buffers via legitimate high-entropy trajectories.
native_carrier: Surprise-driven prioritized replay sampling distributions coupled with online transition model regression updates.
gate: Violated constraint against generic prioritized replay bias, replay poisoning, and catastrophic forgetting.
defense: Task-stratified replay quotas, surprise-metric clipping (capping maximum sample priority based on ensemble variance), and gradient projection (GEM/orthogonal replay updates).
reason: The proposed vector is fundamentally prioritized replay bias leading to standard catastrophic forgetting. While framed around counterfactual planning degradation, the underlying failure mode is standard replay buffer monopolization by high-TD/high-prediction-error transitions, which directly violates the negative constraints excluding generic replay starvation and catastrophic forgetting without introducing a uniquely counterfactual or world-model-specific primitive.
